SENSORIUM. [2] [Astac.]
Dulness in head.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Astac.]
A thick, crusty eruption on scalp, with enlarged lymphatic glands.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Astac.]
Face glowing and red with fever.
Erysipelas with nettlerash.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Astac.]
Canker spots ; scorbutus.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Astac.]
Fulness and pressure in stomach ; burning in epigastrium. θ Gastric and bilious troubles.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Astac.]
Stools color of pipe-clay ; pain in liver.
Diarrhœa with vomiting and colicky pain.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Astac.]
Pain in kidneys ; stinging in night ; < when inhaling.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Astac.]
Jaundice of little children.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Astac.]
Swelling of cervical glands with children and old people.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Astac.]
Inward chilliness, and sensitiveness to air ; worse from uncovering.
   

FEVER. [40] [Astac.]
Violent fever with headache, glowing red face, inward chilliness and sensitiveness to air.
Increase of temperature in evening and slight excitement of sensorium. θ Sopor.
After overheating from exertion and taking cold, first stage of typhoid fever treated with Rhus and Bryon., got much <, with nausealike fainting, fever heat, glowing face, inner chilliness and sensitiveness to air ; after uncovering, greater, long-lasting chill.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Astac.]
Tumors, if not too old.
Gout of drinking people.
   

SKIN. [46] [Astac.]
Nettlerash over whole body.
Nettlerash with liver complaint.
Erysipelas, with fever, headache and increased sweat.
